subject_definitions:
蓝衣女孩 is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with long black hair, a pale blue robe with wide sleeves, and a slim silver hairpin.
黑衣男子 is the young man in <Picture 2>, with hair tied back, a black robe, and dark leather bracers.
红衣女子 is the woman in <Picture 3>, with a crimson robe and a long trailing sash.
红梅雪景 is the snow forest in <Picture 4>, with snow-laden pines, a lone red plum tree in bloom, and drifting snowfall.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video follows 蓝衣女孩 and 黑衣男子, two fellow disciples pushing through the blizzard of 红梅雪景, until they catch sight of 红衣女子 waiting under the red plum tree. Three shots run from a tracking medium shot to a wide reveal and end on a close-up in which 蓝衣女孩 calls out to her.

retention_analysis:
蓝衣女孩 (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the long black hair, pale blue wide-sleeved robe, and silver hairpin are retained.
黑衣男子 (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the tied-back hair, black robe, and dark leather bracers are retained.
红衣女子 (appears in [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the crimson robe and long trailing sash are retained.
红梅雪景 (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the snow-laden pines, blooming red plum tree, and drifting snowfall are retained as the environment of every shot.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic wuxia style with cold blue-grey light, heavy snowfall, and a shallow depth of field.
[Shot 1] A medium tracking shot follows 蓝衣女孩 and 黑衣男子 from the side as they wade through knee-deep snow inside 红梅雪景, snow-laden pines closing in on both sides and wind-driven flakes crossing the frame. 蓝衣女孩, the young woman with long black hair and a pale blue wide-sleeved robe, holds her sleeve against the wind; 黑衣男子, the young man in the black robe with dark leather bracers, walks half a step behind her. 蓝衣女孩 stops abruptly, her eyes widening with surprise and relief as she looks straight ahead, and the camera settles with her.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a wide shot along their line of sight and pushes slowly forward. Under the lone blooming red plum tree of 红梅雪景, 红衣女子 stands motionless with her back to the camera, the crimson robe and long trailing sash the only saturated color in the white field, her sash lifting in the wind.
[Shot 3] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a frontal close-up of 蓝衣女孩 (S1), the young woman in the pale blue robe from Shot 1, snow gathering on her shoulders and tears welling in her eyes. 蓝衣女孩 (S1) calls out in a young female voice, unsteady with held-back emotion, <d>[Chinese] 师姐，我们终于找到你了。</d> She presses her lips together and keeps looking ahead as the wind rises.

overall_soundscape:
Howling wind and dense falling snow continue throughout the video, with muffled footsteps crunching through deep snow in the first shot.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained solo-erhu line at a slow tempo, with sustained low strings underneath that swell gently into the final close-up.
